principles: Operate the English product only; the Korean version is paused until explicitly reactivated.
Run revenue-safety checks before acquisition work.
Block paid campaigns when payment health fails.
Publish only real, approved, or clearly labeled demo evidence.
Keep human approval before public community posts, cold outreach, or social publishing.

cadences.title: Revenue and funnel safety gate
cadences.humanReview: Review critical failures before publishing or sending traffic.

cadences.title: Evidence and case-study candidate extraction
cadences.humanReview: Approve or reject candidates before they become public proof.

cadences.title: Acquisition readiness gate
cadences.humanReview: Review blockers before publishing, launching paid campaigns, or sending high-volume outbound.

cadences.title: Daily ops log sync
cadences.humanReview: Review Slack, Obsidian, and Notion copies. Notion requires connector/manual publish unless a Notion API path is configured.

cadences.title: Inbound outreach reply triage and drafting
cadences.humanReview: Automation only DETECTS replies and writes DRAFTS to Gmail. A human (or the agent in the cloud routine) personalizes each draftBody and runs growth:replies:draft, then reviews and sends from Gmail. Nothing is ever sent automatically.

cadences.title: SEO brief generation
cadences.humanReview: Fact-check market numbers and unsupported claims before publishing posts.

cadences.title: Outbound lead scoring
cadences.humanReview: Personalize every message and cap volume until reply rate is known.

cadences.title: Weekly growth scorecard
cadences.humanReview: Add analytics, MRR, top failed queries, and next experiment decision.

cadences.title: Pre-send outreach preflight
cadences.humanReview: Run before sending any cold outreach. Fails on missing contact provenance, unexplained company/email domain mismatch, or in-batch duplicates. Resolve every critical before sending; review warnings (already-contacted, explained mismatch) manually.

cadences.title: Pre-deploy growth gate
cadences.humanReview: If payment health fails, deploy only changes unrelated to checkout, billing, auth, subscriptions, pricing, or webhooks.
